name: Power Meter
description: A plug-in meter that measures the power an appliance draws and the energy it uses, for software or an Energy Display to read. It has a status LED and beeper.

verification.note: The iMeter Developer Notes describe the meter as i2CS but give 0x01, i2, as its Get Insteon Engine Version reply; the HouseLinc device catalog gives i2CS for firmware 0x30, which the catalog uses.

steps.text: Plug the appliance you want to measure into the outlet on the bottom of iMeter Solo.
Plug iMeter Solo into an unswitched outlet.
steps.expect: iMeter Solo beeps and its status LED turns on solid green; after about 20 seconds it beeps again

notes: Don't plug iMeter Solo into a switched outlet.

steps.text: Press and hold the SET button until iMeter Solo beeps (3 seconds).
steps.expect: iMeter Solo beeps; the iMeter Developer Notes say the LED blinks green until it links or 4 minutes pass

notes: To add iMeter Solo to HouseLinc, first start Auto Link in HouseLinc (the Linking time remaining countdown begins), then hold iMeter Solo's SET button; iMeter Solo appears in the Auto Link list, and clicking OK adds it to the Devices list.

steps.text: While holding down the SET button, plug iMeter Solo back in, making sure not to let go of the SET button.
steps.expect: iMeter Solo beeps and its status LED turns on solid red

steps.text: Continue to hold down the SET button for 3 seconds and then release it.
steps.expect: Status LED turns solid green; after a few seconds iMeter Solo double-beeps
